centre.name: Waterfall viewing circle
centre.origin: plaza centre on the walking surface
centre.waterNote: Actual water sectors exclude the circular deck and all three access bridges. Copy these polygons, not the visual full-pool ellipse, to both world and walk-world water arrays.

animation.note: SVG textures are static in Pixi. Call the supplied module every frame for the flow, foam and ripple pieces. Never animate the stone or rails.

capacity.note: Conservative paving capacity, excludes perimeter clearance and solid furnishings.

integration.coordinates: Centre-local. Translate every x/y, at, sortY and footprint by the island placement origin.
integration.layers: decal/back below characters; sorted/front/anim interleave by sortY. Preserve piece array order for ties.
